units.source_text: ……尽管有这样的经历，但结果如上所述，我还是进了大各大学。

en.t: ... Despite having gone through such an experience, in the end, as I have said, I still entered Otani University.
There was no need for repentance.

units.source_text: 此后过了数日，老师把我和鹤川唤去，简单地吩咐了一句：

en.t: Several days later, the teacher summoned Tsurukawa and me, and gave us a brief instruction:

units.source_text: 应该开始准备考试了，为照顾备考，免去你们干杂务吧。

en.t: You should begin preparing for the examination now; in consideration of your studies, I will excuse you from miscellaneous duties.
